description: This file defines the `SplitUtils` object which provides utility functions for splitting a string into tokens separated by spaces, returning a linked list of tokens.

classes.name: SplitUtils
classes.description: A utility object providing string splitting functions.

methods.name: split
methods.description: Splits a string into tokens based on spaces and returns a linked list of tokens.

methods.name: addIfValid
methods.description: Adds a token to the list if it is valid (not empty).

methods.name: isTokenValid
methods.description: Checks if a token is valid (non-empty).
